title: Fix hyprland keybind for workspace switch
body: The SUPER+1..0 binds were not switching workspaces after the latest hyprland bump. Restore the bind flags and reload.

changed_files.patch:
@@ -12,7 +12,7 @@
-bind = SUPER, 1, workspace, 1
+bind = SUPER, 1, workspace, 1, exact
@@ -20,3 +20,4 @@
+exec-once = hyprctl reload

title: Fix nvidia wayland flicker on external monitor
body: Screen flicker when using NVIDIA proprietary driver with Wayland and an HDMI external display. Set GBM_BACKEND and disable direct scanout.

title: Fix nvidia wayland flicker (HDMI external)
body: Screen flicker when using NVIDIA proprietary driver with Wayland and an HDMI external display. Set GBM_BACKEND and disable direct scanout / WLR_NO_HARDWARE_CURSORS — same nvidia wayland flicker fix.
